WITH spatial_projects AS (
  SELECT 
    sp.aream2,
    sp.volm3,
    sp.boxx,
    sp.boxy,
    p.fundflux
  FROM scanspatial sp
  JOIN projects p ON sp.arcref = p.arcregistry
),
funding_metrics AS (
  SELECT 
    fundflux,
    AVG(CASE 
      WHEN boxx IS NOT NULL AND boxy IS NOT NULL AND boxx <> 0 
      THEN (boxy - boxx) / CAST(boxx AS REAL) 
    END) as avg_y_vs_x_diff,
    AVG(CASE 
      WHEN aream2 IS NOT NULL AND volm3 IS NOT NULL AND volm3 <> 0
      THEN aream2 / CAST(volm3 AS REAL)
    END) as area_volume_ratio
  FROM spatial_projects
  GROUP BY fundflux
),
overall_avg AS (
  SELECT AVG(area_volume_ratio) as overall_avg_ratio
  FROM funding_metrics
  WHERE area_volume_ratio IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT 
  fm.fundflux,
  fm.avg_y_vs_x_diff,
  fm.area_volume_ratio,
  fm.area_volume_ratio - oa.overall_avg_ratio as ratio_above_average
FROM funding_metrics fm
CROSS JOIN overall_avg oa
WHERE fm.area_volume_ratio > oa.overall_avg_ratio
ORDER BY fm.fundflux;
